title: Reserve a personalised vessel registration number
summary: Learn how to reserve a personalized vessel registration number if you plan to sell a vessel that currently has one.
intro:
If you're intending to sell a vessel that has a personalised vessel registration (PVR), and you want to reserve this registration number, you'll need to:

You can do this in person at a service centre, or by mail.
who_can_apply: Intending to sell a vessel that has a personalized vessel registration (PVR).
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Statutory Declaration Vessel Registrations'
An authorized witness to certify the form

how_to_steps.text: Complete the relevant sections of the form.
Visit a service centre to submit your information in person or post it to:Service NSWAgency Business CentrePO Box 21Parkes NSW 2870

faqs.q: How can I reserve a personalized vessel registration number?
faqs.a: You can reserve the number either in person at a service centre or by mail.

faqs.q: What do I need to reserve a personalized vessel registration number?
faqs.a: You need your proof of identity, your registration details, the 'Statutory Declaration Vessel Registrations' PDF form, and an authorized witness to certify the form.
